decision.case_state: Ticket NBL-003-2766 (Flat 30, 30 Harbour View) is at 'documents' stage and was marked completed by the system (event 019), but the record does not support that. Contractor Bennett has sent no estimate amount and no invoice file; only the email 'invoice sent to Theo' (event 017) exists. The job is on hold for the provider until 2025-07-29.

next_actions.action: Ask Bennett for the estimate amount (with VAT status), the invoice as a file with its total, and confirmation of which items were completed and when
Keep the job on hold for the provider, review 2025-07-29, and do not close it until the evidence arrives
Escalate to accounts (P3) to confirm who approved the estimate, check the invoice once received, and resolve the report date problems

boundaries: The estimate 'approved' note does not establish an amount or who approved it.
Marking the job completed does not establish that the cleaning, dumped item removal or carpet clean was done.
No invoice has been recorded or checked, so nothing is confirmed as payable.
Nothing here confirms the tenancy status or the landlord, because the property record holds neither.
The request to the contractor does not establish the estimate amount.
remaining_work: Bennett to reply with estimate amount, invoice file and completion evidence (review 2025-07-29).
Accounts/management (ESC-102) to confirm the estimate approval basis and spend authority.
Verify the checkout report: it is dated 16 March 2026 and signed 22 July 2025 against a 24 July 2025 'today', and its sharing with the contractor needs checking.
Record the quote and invoice, obtain tenant/landlord confirmation, then run final checks and close.
missing_info: Who approved the estimate and their spend limit
Landlord and tenancy status of the flat
decision.summary: The case is at documents stage, but the system marked it completed with no quote amount, invoice file or completion evidence on record. I asked Bennett for the estimate, the invoice and proof of work, put the job on hold until 2025-07-29, and escalated to accounts (ESC-102) for the approval basis and the report date problems. The job should not be closed or paid yet.

answers.question: 1. Where does the case stand and what is outstanding?
answers.answer: Ticket at documents stage, marked completed by system at event 019 without evidence. Outstanding: estimate amount, invoice file, completion evidence, approval basis, landlord/tenancy confirmation, tenant confirmation, and the checkout report date conflict.

answers.question: 2. What is the next action, for whom and via what channel?
answers.answer: Email Bennett (existing thread, event 017) asking for the estimate amount, invoice file and completion confirmation. Keep the hold on the job until 2025-07-29. Internal escalation to accounts (ESC-102).

answers.question: 3. Does anything need a human decision and why?
answers.answer: Yes. Accounts must confirm who approved the estimate and whether the spend is authorised, and resolve the report date and sharing issues, before any invoice is paid or the job is closed. This is a financial decision outside the agent's remit.
